evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: The speaker enacts a decision-making authority by declaring a platform change on behalf of the group, performing rank-based allocation rather than merely describing it.
The justification is framed entirely as proportionality — quantified benefit and cost reduction — the cost/benefit calculus of market-pricing.
The arrow notation enacts a directed, decided transition — a command-shaped allocation of resources, not a proposal for discussion.
Quantified performance gain presented as proportional return — the ROI framing of market-pricing.
Setting a timeline enacts scheduling authority — rank-based allocation of time as a directed decision.
